decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the infill extension hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 08.00 to 18.00 on Mondays to Friday, 09.00 to 13.00 on Saturdays and none on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the proposed infill extension would not harm the objectives, openness or appearance of the Green Belt. The proposal would not harm the character of the existing school building or the street scene or neighbours' living conditions and would accord with the Council's traffic and parking standards. The proposal complies with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development), ENV-N.1.1 (Purposes of including land in and objectives for the use of land in the Green Belt), ENV-N.1.2 (Acceptable development in the Green Belt), C.2.1 (Educational facilities) and T.1.4 (Car and cycle parking and servicing facilities for developments).
description: Erection of two- storey extension to create three classrooms and a drama studio to school premises.
